programme.desc: Over a nine season spell in the Premier League, Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink etched his name into footballing folklore as one of the most dynamic goalscorers in the competition's history. Fourth all time in Premier League goals for Chelsea, Hasselbaink's iconic freekicks and powerful finishes have seen him score some of the League's most memorable goals. Dipandu Oleh Tiga Host Utama Yaitu Komandan Zack, Bro Dim, Dan Miss Binal, Setiap Episodenya Juga Menghadirkan Berbagai Cameo Menarik Seperti Tahanan, Petugas Kebersihan, Hingga Karakter Unik Lainnya Yang Menambah Keseruan. Dengan Gaya Penyajian Yang Ringan, Menghibur, Dan Penuh Humor, Ijin, Ndan Tetap Konsisten Menyampaikan Fakta Aktual Dan Pesan Edukatif Kepada Penonton, Menjadikannya Tontonan Yang Informatif Sekaligus Mengundang Tawa.

programme.title: Canda Empire
programme.desc: Sebuah Acara Komedi Bertemakan Kolosal, Memiliki Format Sketsa Komedi Dengan Latar Belakang Sebuah Kerajaan Bernama Canda Empire Yang Tengah Bergejolak Karena Raja, Mangkat. Hal Ini Membuat Sang Penerus (Megi) Galau Karena Dua Penasehat Utamanya (Sule Dan Jarwo Kwat) Selalu Berbeda Pendapat Yang Mana Hal Tersebut Juga Akan Menghasilkan Kelucuan. Program Ini Juga Menghadirkan Komedian Papan Atas Seperti Parto, Nunung, Azis Gagap, Dan Bintang Tamu Lainnya Di Setiap Episode.

programme.title: Terang Kasih
programme.desc: Siraman Rohani Kristen Yang Berkaitan Dengan Kehidupan Untuk Mendekatkan Diri Kepada Tuhan Yesus Kristus. Program Ini Akan Dibagi Menjadi Beberapa Bagian, Antara Lain Kesaksian, Renungan, Serta Konseling Yang Akan Dipandu Oleh Dua Orang Host.

programme.title: Movinesia
programme.desc: Sebuah Program Yang Menghadirkan Sederet Film Pilihan Untuk Menemani Aktivitas Anda Dengan Dimeriahkan Oleh Para Pemain \u0026 Artis Papan Atas Berbakat, Dengan Cerita Ringan Seputar Kehidupan Remaja.

programme.title: Ustadz On The Road
programme.desc: Program Religi Yang Dipandu Oleh Seorang Host Dan Ustadz Yang Akan Memberikan Kajian Islami Dengan Treatment On The Road Disertai Dengan Study Kasus. Pembahasan Dilakukan Sepanjang Perjalanan Menuju Lokasi Sesuai Agenda Harian Ustadz. Program Ini Akan Disajikan Secara Ringan Dan Menyenangkan.

programme.title: Super Wings
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Perjuangan Jett Dan Timnya Dalam Melindungi Bumi Dan Luar Angkasa Dari Golden Boy, Yang Berhasil Mencuri Sumber Energi Kosmik Kuat Bernama Star Core. Dengan Kekuatan Star Core, Golden Boy Melompati Dimensi Ruang-Waktu Dan Mengancam Keseimbangan Alam Semesta. Untuk Menghentikannya, Tim Super Wings Harus Meluncurkan Markas Besar Ruang Angkasa Mereka, Menjelajahi Berbagai Dimensi Ekstrem, Hingga Terlibat Dalam Pertempuran Robot Raksasa Demi Merebut Kembali Energi Tersebut Dan Menyelamatkan Dunia.

programme.title: Bread Barbershop
programme.desc: Bread, Seorang Tukang Cukur Jenius, Memecahkan Masalah Penampilan Dengan Keterampilan Memotong Rambutnya Yang Briliant. Sekarang Dia Hadir Untuk Memecahkan Masalah Para Bintang Di Bakery Town. Bertentangan Dengan Penampilan Mereka Yang Glamor Dan Bersinar, Para Selebriti Ini Menjalani Hari Yang Sangat Suram. Bread Dan Keluarganya Siap Membantu Para Selebriti Untuk Menemukan Lagi Kebahagiaan Mereka.

programme.title: Hunter X Hunter
programme.desc: Kisah Hunter Hunter Berfokus Pada Seorang Anak Laki-Laki Bernama Gon Freecss, Yang Suatu Hari Menemukan Bahwa Ayahnya Yang Selama Ini Diberitahu Telah Meninggal, Masih Hidup Dan Sehat. Dia Mengetahui Bahwa Ayahnya, Ging Freecss, Adalah Seorang Hunter Legendaris. Terlepas Dari Kenyataan Bahwa Ayahnya Meninggalkan Gon Bersama Kerabatnya Untuk Mengejar Mimpinya, Gon Bertekad Untuk Mengikuti Jejak Ayahnya, Lulus Ujian Hunter, Dan Akhirnya Menemukan Ayahnya Untuk Membuktikan Dirinya Sebagai Hunter Dengan Haknya Sendiri.

programme.title: Beyblade X S3
programme.desc: Beyblade X Mengikuti Ancaman Baru Dari Zero Cross (Zero Kurasu) Dan Keluarganya Yang Berencana Membangun X Tower Baru Demi Sistem Beyblade Tandingan Dan Menghancurkan Menara Lama. Team Persona Harus Berjuang Melindungi X Tower Asli Dengan Menghadapi Anak-Anak Zero.

programme.title: Ultraman Teo
programme.desc: Ultraman Teo Menceritakan Tentang Alien Kesepian Bernama Teo Yang Melarikan Diri Ke Bumi Setelah Planet Asalnya Hancur Diserang Kaiju. Di Bumi, Ia Hidup Sebagai Ibuki Mitsuishi, Seorang Mahasiswa Kedokteran Hewan Yang Berjuang Beradaptasi Dengan Manusia. Saat Monster Yang Sama Menyerang Bumi, Tekadnya Melindungi Makhluk Hidup Mengubahnya Menjadi Ultraman.

programme.title: Yaiba - Samurai Legend
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Petualangan Kurogane Yaiba, Seorang Bocah Liar Yang Dibesarkan Di Hutan Rimba Oleh Ayahnya Untuk Menjadi Seorang Samurai Sejati. Kehidupan Liarnya Berubah Total Saat Ia Harus Pindah Ke Kota Jepang Modern, Di Mana Ia Berteman Dengan Sayaka Mine Dan Masuk Ke Sekolah Formal.

programme.title: Mtlb Goo!
programme.desc: Program Magazine Yang Mengeksplor Tempat-Tempat Unik Dan Mendatangi Orang-Orang Dengan Kisah Menarik. Dikemas Dalam Bentuk Cerita Perjalanan Michael Tjandra Bersama Para Sahabat. Sehingga Selain Banyaknya Informasi Yang Diberikan, Keseruan Pengalaman Perjalanan Michael Tjandra Juga Dihadirkan Kepada Penonton.

programme.title: Adit Sopo Jarwo
programme.desc: Animasi Indonesia, Berisikan Kisah Kehidupan Sehari-Hari Masyarakat Indonesia Yang Dipenuhi Dengan Pengetahuan, Kelucuan, Kisah Persahabatan, Serta Nilai Persatuan, Kesatuan, Dan Kebudayaan. Tokoh Dalam Cerita Ini Diantaranya Adit (Tokoh Utama, Seorang Anak Laki-Laki), Adelya (Adik Adit), Teman-Teman Adit Yakni Dennis, Mitha, Dan Devi. Mereka Harus Berhadapan Dengan Duo Orang Dewasa (Sopo \u0026 Jarwo) Yang Selalu Mencari Celah Untuk Mendapat Keuntungan Tanpa Usaha. Perbedaan Paham Atau Cara Pandang Merupakan Bumbu Utama Yang Memicu Perseteruan Dan Kelucuan. Beruntung Di Antara Mereka Ada H. Udin, Ketua Rw Bijaksana Yang Selalu Menjadi Penengah Dan Memberikan Petuah Bijak Yang Disampaikan Dengan Ringan Serta Lugas Sehingga Mampu Mengembalikan Suasana Gaduh Menjadi Teduh.

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Human survival depends on water, yet global reserves are rapidly shrinking. It has now replaced oil as the most likely cause of global conflict. Discussing whether technology can help secure humanity's future water needs.

programme.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
programme.desc: It's the first quarter-final, and the four chefs who have fought their way through the heats return to the kitchen with everything to play for.

programme.title: John Simpson: 60 Years at the BBC
programme.desc: John Simpson looks back at his extraordinary 60-year career at the BBC - reporting on the biggest global stories of the era. In a frank, personal and revealing documentary, he reflects on the changing world he has witnessed: the revolution in Iran that seemed destined to fail, his brutal kidnapping in Beirut, the fall of the Berlin Wall, two wars in Iraq, the invasion of Afghanistan and a mind-altering trip up the Amazon.

programme.title: This Is BBC TWO

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Nigel and Simon test their driving skills with a 1950s racing game, a collection of shining retro pieces go up for sale, and the dealers are intrigued by a curious Victorian contraption.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: A developer in East Sussex wants to add an extra floor onto a three-storey building. A mum of four is tackling a project in Dorset with the help of relatives. Another family affair in Derbyshire involves sorting out some serious-looking cracks.

programme.title: Mortimer and Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Paul and Bob venture to the northernmost reaches of the UK, Shetland, to fish the lochs and the seas of this remote and beautiful place for trout and pollock.

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Bioacoustics technology and AI reveal how animals communicate, and may soon enable human-animal communication.

programme.desc: Canada's Foreign Minister tells Nick Robinson why she thinks there has been a 'rupture' on the world stage, and where that leaves Canada, the US, Europe and the United Kingdom.

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Contestants compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: Three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle The Answer Run down towards them. Across three rounds, the couples build up their cash pots, but only one pair can face The Final Run and win the chance to take home their cash prize.

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: Calum Clunie has been growing for the Fife veg and flower shows since he was 15 years old, and now he has an allotment in Leven that he has dedicated to growing the largest leeks and most dazzling dahlias.

programme.title: Angels One Five
programme.desc: The Battle of Britain as seen through the eyes of the operations room of a Kent fighter station during the summer of 1940. A young, inexperienced pilot has trouble settling into the routine of squadron life.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team visit Manderston, near Berwick on Tweed. Amongst the items featured are pieces from Queen Victoria's household, a gruesome man trap, and Lord Palmer's collection of rare biscuit tins that were once sold for a few shillings, but which are now valued in their thousands.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Antiques expert Elizabeth Talbot falls for a book of fairytales illustrated by Arthur Rackham, and Adam Partridge discovers an elegant chiming Swiss pocket watch. Paul Martin then meets one of the last remaining survivors of the Dunkirk evacuation during the Second World War.

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Dame Laura Kenny, Minah Shannon, Seann Walsh and Ricky Wilson take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quick-fire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted with the House of Games record player?

programme.title: Strictly Come Dancing: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor is on hand with more Strictly exclusives as she's joined by a brand-new all-star panel to break down the couple's next dances.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Insights and global interviews on the news stories of the day. With Victoria Derbyshire.

programme.title: Live: Sportscene
programme.desc: Live coverage from Hampden as Scotland host North Macedonia in the Nations League.

programme.title: Die Hard With a Vengeance
programme.desc: Third in the series of high-speed thrillers about maverick New York cop John McClane. This time the death-defying lawman, under suspension from the force, goes up against a madman who is threatening to detonate bombs all over Manhattan. McClane pulls out all the stops as he races against the clock to save the city. En route, a hostile Harlem shopkeeper becomes his reluctant partner in the adventure.

programme.title: Blue Story
programme.desc: Best friends Timmy and Marco go to the same high school, but live in neighbouring London boroughs. When Marco gets beaten up by one of Timmy's friends, the two boys wind up on rival sides of a gang war in which there are no winners - only victims.

programme.title: This City Is Ours
programme.desc: Desperate to recover their losses, the Phelans strike a deal with Ozzie Thompson. At Jamie and Melissa's engagement party, Michael and Diana attempt to broker peace with the family. Meanwhile, Freddie spirals further out of Michael's control.

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: Hollywood legend Bill Murray's journey gets underway, from golf in County Cork to chance encounters in Kinsale. Unexpected detours lead to a few surprises along the way.

programme.title: Panorama
programme.desc: The BBC's climate editor Justin Rowlatt investigates the impact of climate change on our weather. He speaks to scientists who warn that hotter summers and wetter winters are likely to become more typical.

programme.title: This Is BBC TWO
programme.desc: A preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: Brinicle invites Pancake onto his radio show but, to his friend's annoyance, his accidental burps prove a hit. Pancake discovers that fame as 'burping guy' has its downsides.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: Dad and Cosima both think they're the best at pranking. Their prank war quickly spirals out of control, until Big Lizard finally reveals Proxima's real pranking champion!

programme.title: Weasy Family
programme.desc: It's bath time! The Ducklings are determined Weasy will get clean.

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: A slimy beast has made the Crystal Mine her home, cutting off the forest's crystal supply, so the heroes must go on a slippery quest to evict her!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings use magic Chinese lanterns for sound and light shows.

programme.title: Duck and Frog
programme.desc: Duck is a referee at a football match, and Frog sees how much a footballer is cheered for scoring a goal. He is desperate to score one himself, but can he get past Duck's red card?

programme.title: Pokémon Horizons: The Series
programme.desc: Liko worries that Hattrem could be holding itself back for the sake of others.

programme.title: Winx Club: The Magic Is Back
programme.desc: Darkness spreads all over Alfea as Flora's parents arrive to help the Winx.

programme.title: The Next Step: Cheer
programme.desc: Cammy accidentally starts a rumour. Damian challenges Layla. Melody tries to catch a cold.

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: News magazine keeping young viewers up to date with the latest stories and events happening at home and abroad.

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: Big Zuu joins Hacker, Abby, and Joel in the Blue Peter studio to support Children in Need.

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: Steve Backshall heads to downtown Perth in search of the most beautiful spider on earth.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don visits the world's 80 most inspiring gardens: this time, in South East Asia. Since the 19th century, Western gardeners have loved the tropical garden. Monty visits the archetype, the mysterious Jim Thompson's Garden in Bangkok. He seeks something more authentic in the Royal Palace gardens and the floating gardens of the canals of Bangkok. In Bali, his preconceptions are challenged again.

programme.title: Naturewatch
programme.desc: Chris Packham, Kyle Thomas and Megan McCubbin explore why geese fly in a V formation, why leaves change colour in autumn and why birds eat rocks.

programme.title: My Life at Christmas with Anita Rani
programme.desc: Rod Stewart and Penny Lancaster welcome Anita Rani into their home to discuss life, family, fame and faith, sharing festive memories, Rod's rise to stardom and Penny's police work.

programme.title: Nadiya's Everyday Baking
programme.desc: Nadiya presents the very best weekend breakfasts for kicking back, relaxing and really indulging in the pleasure of the day's first meal. First up are Nadiya's delectable granola cupcakes for a delicious breakfast on the go.

programme.title: Ice Cold in Alex
programme.desc: A British officer and his ambulance crew discover a German spy in their midst during a harrowing desert trek through Libya in 1942.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Martin wants to run for the hills because of a tricky legal issue in Devon. Jacqui is in Eastbourne, where work is already under way at an end-of-terrace. And Dion goes to Northampton, where a smelly cellar is hard to cope with!

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: The team is at Wolverhampton Art Gallery. Antiques experts James Lewis and Caroline Hawley unearth a sword with a dark history and an early Moorcroft vase, while Paul Martin explores some of the region's industrial past.

programme.title: Live: Match of the Day Wales
programme.desc: Live coverage as Norway takes on Wales in the UEFA Nations League.

programme.title: Live: UEFA Nations League Football
programme.desc: Stephen Watson presents full match coverage from Windsor Park as Northern Ireland take on Ukraine in the UEFA Nations League. With just two matches remaining, Northern Ireland remain firmly in contention for promotion from League B. However, Ukraine could provide a major test as Michael O'Neill's side look to bolster their position ahead of a potentially decisive final fixture. Commentary is by Thomas Kane and Stephen Craigan.

programme.title: 40 Hits of 1985 at the BBC
programme.desc: Featuring the best of the BBC's archives for this selection of 40 songs from 1985, including the likes of Elton John, Duran Duran, Foreigner, Billy Ocean, Marillion, Go West, Strawberry Switchblade and Kirsty MacColl.

programme.title: Godland
programme.desc: At the end of the 19th century, a young Danish priest is sent to a remote part of Iceland. The deeper he travels into the Icelandic landscape, the more he loses a sense of his own reality, his mission and his sense of duty.

programme.title: This City Is Ours
programme.desc: The tragic events of the party send shock waves through the Phelans. As dangerous secrets threaten to come to light, Michael is forced to make a difficult confession to Diana. Meanwhile, unseen dangers close in, and it becomes clear no-one is safe.

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: The second leg of the race takes the teams across the heart of Borneo to a modern metropolis on its eastern coast and their second checkpoint.

programme.title: This Is BBC TWO
programme.desc: A preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

programme.title: My Life at Christmas with Anita Rani
programme.desc: Anita Rani meets Paralympian and broadcaster Ade Adepitan to hear his inspirational life story and how sport, spirituality and the festive season have shaped him. Anita discovers his life-affirming Christmas story, from contracting polio as a toddler in Nigeria, to growing up with a disability in east London in the 1970s, to the rocky road that led to Paralympic glory with the British wheelchair basketball team. Now a respected broadcaster, Ade shines a light on causes close to his heart.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Charlotte Smith and Adam Henson explore how dairy farmers across County Antrim are turning to tech and innovative business models to build a more resilient future.

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie visits a nature reserve in Castlemilk that has transformed into a thriving green place. Meanwhile, Anne hears about a charity providing bereavement support for kids across the Highlands.

programme.title: BBC Children in Need
programme.desc: Radio 1 presenter Sian Eleri follows Pudsey Bear's clues on a road trip around Wales to meet the special young people and projects benefiting from BBC Children in Need funding.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Andi Oliver takes a classic British dessert and transforms it into a savoury number with her three cheese and leek bread and butter pudding. Niklas Ekstedt brings the taste of Sweden to the studio with the iconic Jansson's temptation.

programme.title: Best Bakes Ever
programme.desc: With Britain more obsessed with baking than ever, actress and cake expert Jane Asher brings together a selection of recipes from the nation's favourite television chefs, for 'Best Bakes Ever'.

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
programme.desc: Nigel Slater creates simple but delicious meals from ingredients that are often overlooked, including a lentil and chard stew.

programme.title: Jane Eyre
programme.desc: Charlotte Bronte's classic about an orphan girl who grows up to become a governess in a gloomy manor in Yorkshire, where she falls in love with the mysterious Edward Rochester.

programme.title: Spellbound
programme.desc: Hitchcock thriller in which a psychoanalyst falls in love with her new boss, knowing that he is an amnesiac who may be a killer and an impostor. Characteristically Hitchcockian twists blur reality and imagination as the psychoanalyst struggles to restore his memory. A dream sequence designed by Salvador Dali adds to the suspense.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: A collection of interesting finds from the show's travels round the country, visiting Margam Country Park in south Wales, Highcliffe Castle in Dorset and Powderham Castle in Devon. Paul also takes a look at the treasures at Firle Place.

programme.title: DP World Tour Championship, DP World Tour Golf
programme.desc: Final day highlights as the DP World Tour season reaches its climax. The winner of the Race to Dubai is crowned, with Northern Ireland's Rory McIlroy having won the last four editions. McIlroy has won seven Race to Dubai titles, putting him one behind Colin Montgomerie's all-time record.

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: The third leg of the race sees the teams leave behind the jungles of Borneo to reach the island of Sulawesi, an Indonesian wonderland that lies far from the tourist trail.

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: As the days grow longer, the MacDonalds round up their pregnant Highland cattle on the tiny island of Vallay, off North Uist, for a prenatal check-up and vitamin boost. Meanwhile, Jenni's new alpaca arena is finally finished in Newtonmore.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Eva charts the history of French cuisine via a seven-course fine dining meal aboard a Seine riverboat.

CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.
